name: Aroha Tamati
bio:
Aroha Tamati's journey into motorsport security began unconventionally. After a career in the New Zealand Police, specializing in high-risk security details, she transitioned her skills to the high-octane world of racing. Her sharp eye for detail and proactive approach quickly earned her a reputation for maintaining order and preventing breaches.

At PEX Motorsport, Aroha is known for her meticulous planning and calm demeanor under pressure. She focuses on preventative measures, conducting thorough risk assessments and implementing robust security protocols. While she respects team dynamics, Aroha is comfortable operating independently, often uncovering potential vulnerabilities others might miss. Her blend of law enforcement experience and motorsport passion makes her an invaluable asset.

physical.hairStyle: Short, practical bob, often pulled back with a clip.
physical.description: Aroha has a sturdy build and a no-nonsense expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Insists on checking every security camera feed at least once a day.
Has a surprisingly good sense of humour, but only when she's off-duty.
